esteban_sales: RegBank asks if we can do a 3-week POC to validate Thales Luna BYOK + rotation rollback SLA (they want 24h). Need timeline, cost delta, and what to include in the security questionnaire. Can eng/security advise?

praveen_eng: I can lead. Quick: will they use envelope encryption or expect CMK ops for every DEK? Also need reachability (relay VM vs direct).

esteban_sales: Envelope encryption. They'll provide a relay VM in their VPC.

amanda_security: Security required items: signed attestation manifest from HSM vendor, firmware version, and proof of operator identity. Attestation needs 7yr retention.

siva_sre: Ops: 24h rollback OK if we retain at least 2 previous key versions and have runbook + dry-run. We'll need static IP allowlist and mTLS.

billing_bot: Rough pricing: one-time PS BYOK integration $12k-$18k; monthly KMS ops delta ~$0.02/1k requests; reserved capacity uplift ~+20% estimate. Formal quote to follow.

ola_solutions: I'll draft a 1-pager POC plan (network, import test, perf p50/p95, rotation dry-run). Security: please provide exact attestation fields we should ask for.

amanda_security: Attestation manifest fields: key-id, import-time (ISO8601), hsm-serial, firmware-version, signer-cert-fingerprint, operator-id, signature. We'll supply suggested questionnaire copy.

esteban_sales: Scheduling kickoff for Mon 9am PT. I'll include SOW sketch and PS estimate. Follow-ups in a new thread after the call.
